_about: audit_logged, route by route, read by a person on 2026-11-19 (API-1119 resign2). true = the route itself writes an audit row on every success path (writer named); false = no audit row on the success path, whatever the static walk reaches. A row overrules the walk both ways; the wide walk never credits without a true row here. Hand-written.

POST /api/books/periods/:fy/:p/reopen.writer: lib/books-year-reopen.js reopenMonth -> store.logChange (books_change_log: who, the month, hard_locked to open, the reason)
POST /api/books/periods/:fy/:p/reopen.why: the one success path writes the change-log row in the same call before it answers

POST /api/books/year/:fy/reopen.writer: lib/books-year-reopen.js reopenYear -> store.logChange (books_change_log: who, the year, closed to open, the reason)
POST /api/books/year/:fy/reopen.why: the one success path writes the change-log row before it answers

POST /api/books-grants.writer: lib/books-grant.js give -> recordEvent -> access-events record (access_events books_grant_given)
POST /api/books-grants.why: every grant given writes its access_events row in the same transaction

PATCH /api/books-grants/:id.writer: lib/books-grant.js change -> recordEvent (access_events books_grant_changed, before and after)
PATCH /api/books-grants/:id.why: every change writes before and after

POST /api/books/move-in/import.writer: lib/move-in.js apply -> move-in-proof store (move_in_import: who, when, counts, proof; b765)
POST /api/books/move-in/import.why: each import keeps an attributed, read-back record (GET /move-in/imports); the row exists once b765 is on, which proof_stored in the answer says

POST /api/books/opening/preview.why: writes nothing (a dry run); the static walk reaches logChange through the replace path it does not take

POST /api/books/opening.why: posts the opening entry (carries by); books_change_log is written only by the replace route, and by a first-use account creation, not on every success

POST /api/books/entries.why: posts a journal entry (carries by); the only logChange on that path is a ledger account created on first use, not every success

POST /api/books/write-off.why: posts a write_off entry (carries by); logChange only for a first-use account, not every success

POST /api/books/cheques/:id/status.why: posts a cheque_step entry (carries by); logChange only for a first-use account, not every success

POST /api/books/parties/:id/dispute.why: posts a party_status entry (carries by); logChange only for a first-use account, not every success

POST /api/books/fx-revalue.why: posts the revaluation entry (carries by); logChange only for a first-use account, not every success

POST /api/chits/hand-over-all.why: chit moves write state_log through the assign writer, follow-up moves (moveFollowups -> rerouteFollowups) write no row: half the hand-over is unaudited

POST /api/notifications/dismiss.why: writes notif_dismissed, the caller's own feed state, not an audit row
